goal.label: Goal
goal.content: We connect local businesses with domestic customers through a platform that makes it easy to promote and book tourism services, boosting the local economy and improving the customer experience.

problem.label: Problem identified
items: Local businesses struggle to promote themselves effectively in the digital market.
There is no comprehensive platform that brings together local tourism and leisure services in one place.
Customers look for centralized options to plan activities and book services.
Low visibility for small and medium tourism businesses.

solution.label: Proposed solution
solution.content: A digital platform (web and app) where businesses can register and promote their services.

features.label: Key features
items: Easy business registration with customizable profiles
Customer reviews and ratings to build trust
Online booking and integrated payments for a frictionless experience
Personalized recommendation system based on user preferences
Analytics tools so businesses can understand their performance

items.title: Freemium.
items.text: Free registration for small businesses with basic features.

items.title: Premium subscription.
items.text: Businesses pay monthly/annual fees for advanced features.

items.title: Commissions.
items.text: Revenue from transactions made on the platform.

items.title: Advertising.
items.text: Paid promotional placements within the platform for greater visibility.

items.title: Additional services.
items.text: Photography, design and digital marketing services.

financials.label: Financial projections
financials.initialInvestmentText: Includes platform development, infrastructure, initial marketing and 6 months of operations. Figures are estimates for illustrative purposes, based on business plan assumptions.
roiItems: First stage (1-2 years): projected recovery of 70-100% of the investment, based on the financial model's assumptions.
Second stage (3 years): projected profit margin of 30-50% annually, subject to actual market conditions.

market.label: Market potential
items: Sustained growth in local tourism and business digitalization.
Broad target audience: domestic and international tourists, families, event organizers.

scalability.label: Scalability
items: Expansion to more countries or regions.
Introduction of new service categories, such as corporate events or specialized rentals.

advantages.label: Competitive advantages
items: Cutting-edge AI technology for personalized recommendations.
Flexible business model that adapts to different company sizes.
